description: List the JavaScript files a scanned page loaded, each with its fingerprint: hashes (SHA-256, SHA-1, MD5, normalized and fuzzy), size metrics, detected library and bundler. The include_* options add function lists, HTTP headers or ML vector details. Paginated with limit (default 20) and offset: total_scripts is the scan's number of scripts and fingerprints_count the number returned. Useful for collecting script hashes to search for elsewhere. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

include_functions.description: Include the list of functions extracted from each script.
include_functions.title: Include Functions

include_http_headers.description: Include the HTTP response headers each script was served with.
include_http_headers.title: Include Http Headers

include_vectors_info.description: Include whether machine-learning similarity vectors exist for each script.
include_vectors_info.title: Include Vectors Info

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.
offset.title: Offset

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

name: get_js_fingerprints
title: Get JS Fingerprints
